title: PostgreSQL Autovacuum and Table Bloat
realWorldScenario: A high-frequency orders table receives 500,000 updates daily. Over two months, disk usage doubled even though the active row count remained constant at 1 million rows.
questionStatement: What causes Table Bloat in PostgreSQL? Explain what the VACUUM process does, and why VACUUM FULL should be used with extreme caution.
expectedConcepts: Standard VACUUM reclaims space internally without blocking
VACUUM FULL acquires ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and rewrites file
Table bloat impact on memory cache and sequential scans
hints: Standard VACUUM is online; VACUUM FULL is an exclusive lock rewrite.
